meta.title: PreviewKit — Real-Time Previews for Custom Phone Case Stores
meta.description: Let customers see their exact phone case design before checkout. Fewer returns, fewer disputes, higher conversion. Works with Shopify in minutes.

hero.eyebrow: Built for Custom Phone Case Stores
headline: Let customers see their
exact case before they buy.
hero.sub: Stop losing sales to guesswork. PreviewKit adds a real-time design preview to your Shopify store — so buyers are confident at checkout, not after delivery.

problem.headline: Your buyers are guessing. That's costing you.
problem.sub: When customers can't see exactly how their case will look, doubt kills the sale — or worse, they buy and regret it.

points.title: Returns & Disputes
points.body: "It doesn't look like I expected." Without a real preview, customers make assumptions — and when the case arrives, you deal with the fallout.

points.title: Manual Proof Requests
points.body: Your team spends 20–40 minutes per order creating mockups, sending emails, and waiting on approvals — for every single custom order.

points.title: Alignment Complaints
points.body: Off-centre images, cropped faces, wrong layout. These are 100% preventable — but only if the customer can see the final placement before checkout.

solution.headline: Show the final design before checkout.
solution.sub: PreviewKit adds a live preview tool directly on your product page. Customers upload their photo, position it exactly how they want, and confirm — before they pay.

pillars.label: Real-Time Preview
pillars.sub: Buyers see the exact final case as they customise — no imagination required

pillars.label: Print-Ready Output
pillars.sub: A production-quality file is generated automatically with every confirmed order

pillars.label: Paste & Go
pillars.sub: One code snippet added to your Shopify theme. No rebuilds, no dev work

pillars.label: Your Brand
pillars.sub: Colours, labels, and styling match your store — fully configurable

howItWorks.headline: From photo upload to print-ready in seconds.

steps.label: Upload
steps.body: Customer uploads their photo on your product page. Resolution is checked automatically — no bad files reach production.

steps.label: Preview
steps.body: They see the design on the case in real time. Drag, pinch, zoom until it looks exactly right.

steps.label: Confirm
steps.body: One tap locks the design. A 300 DPI print file is generated and stored — no manual steps.

steps.label: Deliver
steps.body: Your team receives a print-ready file with the order. Zero back-and-forth. Zero guesswork.

buyerValues.label: Confidence at Checkout
buyerValues.body: Buyers see the exact final product before paying. No surprises on delivery.

buyerValues.label: Full Control
buyerValues.body: They position, zoom, and fine-tune the design until it's perfect — entirely on their own.

buyerValues.label: Fewer Returns
buyerValues.body: What they see is what they get. Disputes, refund claims, and reprints drop significantly.

comparison.headline: The old way is costing you money.

infrastructure.headline: Ready for your next 1,000 orders.
infrastructure.sub: PreviewKit is designed for stores that are scaling. Whether you sell 10 cases a week or 10,000, it handles every order without adding to your team's workload.

pillars.label: Works Across Products
pillars.body: Add real-time preview to any custom product — phone cases, mugs, apparel. New products go live in minutes, not weeks.

pillars.label: Shopify Native
pillars.body: Drop it into your product template and it just works. No rebuilds, no custom dev, no ongoing maintenance.

pillars.label: Unlimited Orders
pillars.body: One setup serves your entire store. Every order gets its own isolated preview and print file — automatically.

contact.headline: See it live on your store.
contact.sub: Share a few details and we'll set up a live preview on your actual product page — usually before the call ends.

footer.tagline: Real-time previews for custom phone case stores.
